346087.昔 魔皇軍が 各地を侵略していた頃\n秘伝の術を受け継ぐ 破邪舟師 セルジュが\:
Long ago, when the Dark Dominion continued its invasion in many lands...there was a boy named Serju. He was a "Ship Shaper"ーan art
inherited from ages past. He set off to the dark continent of Tenebresia aboard his Sacred Ship.

346088.しかし 魔大陸には到達したものの\n破邪舟は 魔皇軍の攻撃を受けて 谷底に落ち\:
Although he reached that dark land, his vessel came under attack by the Dark Dominion's forces. Plunging into the depths of the valley
below, he fell into the underworld...

346089.どうにか不時着した そこは 魔界と呼ばれる\n場所でした。脱出しようにも 破邪舟:
He managed to survive in a realm known as the
Demon World. As for his escape...his Sacred
Ship was in no condition to fly any longer.

346090.セルジュは 破邪舟を 召喚しなおそうと\n試みましたが 魔界の悪い空気に侵され\:
Serju attempted to summon his ship once again,
but the tainted atmosphere of the Demon World
stunted his magical power.

346091.そこに カブトムシのような 奇妙な格好をした\n魔族の少年 ポポルゾーラが 現れ:
It was then that a strange boy named
Poporuzora appeared. He looked just like
a rhinoceros beetle.

346092.ポポルゾーラは 警戒するセルジュに\n何があったのかと ひどく尊大な態度で\nた:
With an arrogant demeanor about him, the
boy asked a wary Serju what had happened.

346093.セルジュが事情を話すと ポポルゾーラは\n魔大陸に乗り込もうとした 気概を気に入:
Popoluzora was impressed by Serju's
determination to reach Tenebresiaーso he lent
him enough power for his summoning to succeed.

346094.そのおかげで セルジュは\n破邪舟の召喚に成功し 故郷の町に\n帰還することが:
And thanks to his help, Serju was able to
once again summon the Sacred Ship and
return home.

346095.しかし 町の人たちは\nセルジュの帰還を 喜んだのも束の間\n破邪舟の形状に 目:
Though they rejoiced at Serju's return, the
townspeople soon found themselves in
astonishment over the ship's appearance...

346096.それもそのはず 新しい破邪舟は すっかり\nポポルゾーラ好みの 怪しげな甲虫を模:
No wonder they did! The new Sacred Ship had
been designed to look just like a rather
suspicious beetle...

346097.しかし セルジュは\nポポルゾーラとの 友情の証として\nその後も その破邪舟を:
And so, as a token of his friendship with
Popoluzora, Serju continued to sail the
new Sacred Ship.

346098.ある村に ヨルとヒノデという\nふたりの少女が おりました。:
In a certain village somewhere, there lived
two girls named Yoru and Hinode.

346099.ふたりとも 身寄りはありませんでしたが\nヒノデが 村長の家で 召使いとして働く:
Neither of them had any family to speak of. While Hinode worked as a servant of the village chief, Yoru was a singer beloved by
everyone there.

346100.村人たちは皆 ヨルの歌声に惹きつけられ\nヒノデも 広場から かすかに聞こえる\:
The villagers were captivated by her beautiful singing. Even Hinode had fallen under its spell, faintly hearing her drifting voice from
the town square.

346101.ヒノデは 掃除や料理をしながら\nヨルの歌を 口ずさむようになりました。:
While doing her chores like cleaning and
cooking, Hinode began humming Yoru's
songs.

346102.ある日 ヒノデが いつものように\n歌いながら 庭を掃除していると\nたまたま:
One day, while Hinode was cleaning the garden
with her usual humming, Yoru happened to
pass by.

346103.ヒノデの歌声を聞いた ヨルは\nヒノデも 歌い手になるべきだと言い\n一緒に歌お:
Upon hearing her singing voice, Yoru suggested
that she too should become a singerーinviting
her to sing as a duet.

346104.しかし ヒノデは 人前で歌うなんて\n自分なんかにはできないと 断るのでした。:
However, she refused... Singing in front of
others was just not possible for her.

346105.ある日 買い出しで 近隣の王国を訪れたヒノデは\nムーリス王に歌を披露する予定の:
Then, while visiting a neighboring kingdom for errands one day, Hinode heard that Yoru's wagon had never arrived. She was supposed to
sing for the kingdom's ruler, King Mooris.

346106.気分屋の王が ヨルを追放するというお触れを\n出そうとするので ヒノデが止めに入:
The fickle king meant to banish Yoru for her insolence. Hinode stepped in to stop him, offering to sing in her place until she
arrived.

346107.しかし 人前で歌ったことがない ヒノデは\n声が震えてしまい うまく歌えません。:
However, with no experience singing in front of others, Hinode found it impossible to sing wellーher voice trembling. Murmurs rippled
through the crowd as King Mooris frowned...

346108.そこに 壊れかけの馬車が 飛び込んできて\nさっそうと ヨルが降り立ちます。彼女:
Just then, a battered wagon came rushing in, with Yoru making her grand entrance. Taking Hinode by her hand, she begins singing to
her as if she were just speaking.

346109.その歌でヒノデも歌えるようになり ムーリス王は\nふたりの歌声に 大感激です。や:
From that song, Hinode finally learned to
sing. King Mooris was deeply moved, and the
two became singers renowned around the world.

346110.あるところに 無職でありながら\n親の遺産のおかげで 大金持ちのペルパン卿が\n:
Once upon a time, there lived a man named Perpan. While he had no job, he was extremely wealthy and led an elegant life in a grand
mansion thanks to the inheritance from his parents.

346111.ある日 ペルパン卿のもとに 怪盗パクールから\n財宝をいただくという 予告状が届:
One day, Perpan received a warning from the notorious phantom thief Pakool, announcing his intention in stealing some of his treasure.
This prompted Perpan in increasing security at his mansion.

346112.しかし 予告当日の深夜 ペルパン卿が\n寝ている隙に 怪盗パクールは警備をかいく:
Howeverーin the dark hours of the night of the supposed dateーPakool was able to sneak into the mansion undetected while Perpan
slept soundly. The thief managed to snatch the treasure he coveted.

346113.その時 突然 窓を破壊して\n金色に輝く 月をバックに\nパンツ一丁の屈強な男が:
Just then, a man clad in nothing but his underwear crashed through the window, the backdrop of the golden moon setting
him aglow.

346114.その男は 名探偵カンダタ。カンダタは\n床を殴って 陥没させると 亀裂に足を取ら:
He was Robbin' 'Ood, ace detective. After punching the floor and causing it to collapse, a trapped Pakool was finally caught and handed
over to the guards of the mansion.

346115.騒ぎで目を覚ました ペルパン卿は\nお礼に なんでもほしいものをやろうと\nカン:
Awakened by the commotion, Perpan told
Robbin' 'Ood that he could have anything he
desired as a token of his gratitude.

346116.しかし 彼は 自分の正義に従っただけだと言い\nさっそうと 立ち去ろうとします。:
However, he claimed that he needed no reward
and simply followed his sense of justice,
prepared to leave with a sense of confidence.

346117.ところが その行く手を 警備兵が阻み\nお前を見逃すわけにはいかないと 言って\:
The guards blocked his way, declaring that
he was not allowed to leave while
apprehending him.

346118.こうして カンダタは 器物損壊罪と\nパンツ一丁で出歩いた罪で 怪盗パクールと共:
And so, along with Pakool...Robbin' 'Ood was
hauled away, charged with destruction of
property and public indecency.

346119.昔 オーグリード大陸に\nゾルバロンという 凶暴な魔物が現れ\n人々を 恐怖に陥:
Long ago, a ferocious beast called Zorbalon
appeared in the lands of Ogreed, plunging
its people into utter terror.

346120.その頃 オーグリード大陸で 一二を争う\n武勇の持ち主 アモレドと ジークという:
At the time, there existed two young warriors named Amored and Sieg. They were renowned for being the most formidable fighters in all the
land.

346121.ふたりは オーグリード大陸の人々を守るため\nゾルバロンの討伐に 乗り出します。:
To protect the people of Ogreed, the two set
out to put an end to Zorbalon's tyranny.

346122.アモレドと ジークは\n武芸の神と呼ばれる 尊翁グリフベーンのもとで\n共に修業:
The two warriors were as close as friends could be, having trained under the venerable Grifbaneーa man revered as a god of martial
arts.

346123.それと同時に ふたりは\n幼馴染のマリスに 恋心を抱いていました。:
However, the both of them also harbored
feelings for their mutual childhood friend,
Maris.

346124.そこで ふたりは\nゾルバロンを 討ち取ったほうが\nマリスに結婚を申し込もうと:
The two of them then made a pactーthe one
who manages to stop Zolbaron is the one who
would propose to Maris.

346125.しかし 凶暴なゾルバロン相手に\nアモレドも ジークも 防戦一方で\n一向に 勝:
However, the ferocious beast forced the two
fighters into a defensive approach.
Victory seemed impossible...

346126.そこに マリスが現れ ゾルバロンに\n飛び蹴りを くらわしました。休む間もなく\:
As if from nowhere, Maris appeared and delivered a powerful kick to the monster. After unleashing a relentless barrage of
punches, Zorbalon finally fell.

346127.マリスは 尊翁の娘で\n一門に伝わる奥義の 継承者だったのです。:
Maris was the daughter of the venerable
master, heir to the secret techniques
passed down through her family.
